item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 10: Rams produce upset of the season as Suiside’s undefeated reign ends
item.description: The Rams produced an almighty upset this weekend in the men’s division 1 softball, becoming the first side to conquer Suiside and put an end to their undefeated streak.

item.title: Geraldton water polo round 10: Demons survive early scare to cling on to top spot in women’s A-grade
item.description: Demons steadied themselves after an early scare from Rats in the Women’s A-grade clash on Saturday afternoon, eventually running out 10–5 winners to close out the final round before the Christmas break.

item.title: New group, Fish for All, formed in bid to convince State Government to pause its demersal fishing bans
item.description: A coalition of fishing-related businesses have banded together in a last-ditch bid to convince the State Government to pause its ban on demersal fishing while an independent stock assessment is carried out.

item.title: Fatal and serious crashes: 13yo girl seriously injured in car crash in Bookara in Mid West
item.description: Major crash investigators are probing a car rollover south of Geraldton on Friday night which seriously injured a 13-year-old girl.

item.title: Space communication and sustainable canola oil see Mid West women recognised for their achievements
item.description: Two Mid West leaders have been nominated for the AgriFutures Rural’s Women’s Award for 2026, which could see them granted with a $15,000 bursary towards their projects.

item.title: Man dies after losing control of a rental e-scooter in Geraldton
item.description: An e-scooter rider has died in Geraldton after losing control of the machine in the early hours.

item.title: Three WA women announced as finalists in 2026 WA AgriFutures Rural Women’s Award
item.description: Three regional women with ambitious projects stretching from the farm gate to the Moon have been named finalists in this year’s WA AgriFutures Rural Women’s Award.

item.title: West Coast investigate Tyler Brockman’s alleged involvement in Geraldton fight that hospitalised one man
item.description: West Coast is probing a violent street fight allegedly involving footballer Tyler Brockman, in an incident that has left one man in hospital — and could jeopardise the player’s prospects with the club.

item.title: Geraldton Buccaneers farewell homegrown champ Johny Narkle after he signs with Cockburn Cougars in NBL1 West
item.description: Geraldton Buccaneers will be without one of its biggest stars next year, with homegrown championship player Johny Narkle signing with the Cockburn Cougars for the 2026 NBL1 West season.

item.title: Mollina Ryan: Bail bid for woman accused of murdering a man at Geraldton
item.description: A woman charged with the murder of a man on a street in Geraldton has applied for bail
